text:
sam-support: Heads-up — NimbleApp is seeing content regressions after last weekend's model rollout. They say invoice summaries now drop line items intermittently. They provided 3 request IDs. Need minimal repro + prompt logs to escalate. cc @anna-cs @jess-eng

anna-cs: Thanks. Can you paste the customer's example and the 3 request IDs? We'll need the prompt logs and model version. Also confirm if they used streaming or function calls.

sam-support: Customer snippet and IDs below:
```
Customer input: "Summarize invoice for order 4271, list items and totals"
Request IDs: req_20260311_az1, req_20260311_az2, req_20260312_bx1
Model used: open-redwood-v2-4b
Observed: omitted 2 line items in 2/3 responses
```

jess-eng: thanks. Any chance they included content with HTML tags or tables? Those can break tokenization. Also paste the prompt wrapper you send (system/user messages).

sam-support: wrapper we send:
```
System: "You are an assistant that summarizes invoices. Keep itemized lists, preserve currency formats." 
User: "<invoice_html>...</invoice_html>"
```

mike-ml: pinging @jess-eng and @anna-cs — I can run a quick repro locally. Do we have the prompt logs (full request payload + headers) for req_20260311_az1? If not, ask SRE for request dumps. Also check whether KV cache was enabled for that customer pool.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: open-redwood-v2-4b @ 2026-03-10T02:14Z by jess-eng (rollout: 100%)

jess-eng: I'll try to repro with the exact wrapper and the customer's input. If I can reproduce, we should collect a minimal input that still triggers the omission and then run automated eval across quantized/model variants. If not reproducible, we need full prompt logs + tokenization dump.

sam-support: On it — emailing customer for raw request payload and consent for logs. ETA 2 hours. Will post when we have dumps.

mike-ml: If we do reproduce, consider pinning the customer to previous model variant and open a rollback ticket. Also flag for quality regression alert.

anna-cs: thx. Please add the 3 request IDs to the internal case and mark priority P2. :pray:
